spans.s: (prob. fr. √ यत्) N. of a celebrated monarch of the lunar race (son of king Nahuṣa whom he succeeded ; from his two wives came the two lines of the lunar race, Yadu being the son of Devayānī, daughter of Uśanas or Śukra, and Puru of Śarmiṣṭhā, daughter of Vṛṣa-parvan; Yayāti Nāhuṣa is also represented as the author of RV. ix, 101, 4-6), RV.; MaitrUp.; MBh.; Kāv. &c.
ययाति—चरित n. ‘the story of Yayāti’, N. of a Nāṭaka (by Rudra-deva).
ययाति—जा f. patr. of Mādhavī, MBh.
ययाति—पतन n. ‘fall of Y˚’, N. of a place of pilgrimage, ib.
ययाति—व॑त् ind. like Y˚, RV.
ययाति—विजय m. ‘Y˚ victory’, N. of wk.
= ययाति, AgP.
one conversant with the history of Yayāti, Pat. on Pāṇ. iv, 2, 60.

the life of a vagrant mendicant, BhP.
